long_scenario.trigger: Reclaim dVAL ~77.43k and hold/retest above it.
long_scenario.confirmation: CVD stays stable/up and OI does not rise while price stalls; ideally price progresses toward the next structural area rather than immediately falling back below dVAL.

short_scenario.trigger: Price probes/reclaims ~77.43k dVAL but cannot accept above and rolls back below.
short_scenario.confirmation: Lower high/rejection below or around dVAL; CVD stalls/turns down; OI stays elevated or rises while price weakens.
short_scenario.avoid: Do not short merely because price is below dVAL before a rejection sequence; current flow still shows active recovery.

edge_note: This frame is a live out-of-sample test of the recovery-efficiency/failed-reclaim hypothesis. Do not label the edge VERIFIED from this episode; record the subsequent outcome without lookahead.
lesson: At a structural boundary after capitulation, the decision is not made by Price/CVD/OI direction alone. Reclaim-and-accept favors the long path; probe-and-reject with weak price efficiency favors the short path. Wait for acceptance/rejection evidence instead of trading the midpoint of the decision zone.
